Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final production character illustration for a layered animated web portrait.
Reference image: The comparison board supplied contains three styles. Use ONLY column B, PAINTED FOLKLORE, top-row MINOTAUR as the visual identity and painting style. This is an expansion of that exact chosen design into a standalone high-resolution transparent cutout. Do not use column A's sculpted render or column C's naturalism.
Primary request: One full-body painted Minotaur on true transparent background, portrait 4:5 aspect ratio, approximately 1280x1600 pixels or larger. All horns, hands, tail and hooves must fit inside with 8% clear space around the silhouette.
Character: heavyweight bovine beast warrior, broad sloping shoulders, thick neck integrated into torso, massive forearms with closed dark leathery fists, compact but powerful legs, planted cloven hooves. Strong real bull skull, broad short bovine muzzle, dark wet nostrils, small deeply recessed amber eyes visible on both sides, heavy brows, large weathered ivory horns curving outward then upward, tufted rust-brown fur concentrated around crown, cheeks, neck and forearms, shorter smooth coat on torso. Distinct bare leathery muzzle, horn keratin, worn brown leather diagonal chest strap and rough dark loincloth. Small tail curving behind one leg. No weapons or added armor.
Pose: near-frontal three-quarter orientation with head facing viewer, slight forward hunch, balanced relaxed threatening stance, both arms separated slightly from torso, fists around upper thigh height; no extreme action pose. Eyes open and calm watchful expression, closed mouth with only two subtle small lower tusks. Anatomy should be designed like the column B reference, not a human body with a bull mask.
Style: actual hand-painted dark folklore fantasy illustration, confidently placed textured brushstrokes, painterly uneven silhouette edges, warm ochre lit planes against rich dark umber and plum shadows, selectively detailed face and materials, small organic asymmetry. Clearly painted, NOT a 3D render, NOT airbrushed, NOT photorealistic, NOT a glossy collectible, NOT low-poly or pixel art. Strong readable shapes at phone size.
Lighting: broad soft warm light from upper left, readable dark planes, subtle cool reflected fill, shadows painted into the character. No rim halo.
Background: genuine alpha transparency. No scenery, no ground plane, no baked drop shadow, no pedestal, no particles or magic, no text or labels, no frame, no watermark. One creature only. Keep crisp painted silhouette with natural furry edge, not white fringe. This will be animated with subtle chest/head mesh deformation, so pose and coherent anatomy are more valuable than effects.

The whole S-curve occupies the tall portrait with some negative space inside each curve. Maintain calm suspended coiled pose ready for subtle fin and body sway.
